correctness.rationale: Averaging reduces the optimum, two explicit spectral blocks give the correct SLEM, strict q-monotonicity and strict scalar convexity prove one analytic optimizer, and a common-kernel PSD argument proves all globally optimal feasible matrices are symmetric and identical. value.rationale: The clique corona is a structurally motivated exact graph family explicitly treated by earlier consensus and stochastic studies. The nonnegative holding-probability restriction changes an otherwise infeasible signed optimum. Complete radical formulas for an unbounded family, limiting SLEM 4/5 and all-feasible-matrix uniqueness settle a substantive uncovered boundary, not an arbitrary finite computation.
